description: The SEEG initiative publishes an English spreadsheet of estimated Brazilian greenhouse gas emissions for 1970 to 2015. The named Figshare data item contains sector and activity accounts for energy, industrial processes, land use and other sources, with documentation tabs. These figures can calibrate national energy or industrial emissions scenarios and provide a historical check on simulated mitigation pathways. They are estimates compiled from several official and other sources, not direct sensor records of individual facilities. The database is periodically revised on the SEEG website, so users should keep the version and accounting method with any model input. The Figshare data item states CC0, although the containing collection has a different CC BY 4.0 registration. I read the Scientific Data descriptor and own item metadata without opening the workbook. No directly related catalogue record was found.
